## Why

What user problem does this change address?

## What changed

Describe the smallest meaningful set of changes.

## Evidence and trust

- [ ] Source facts, PaperWork inferences, suggestions, conflicts, and unconfirmed information remain visibly distinct.
- [ ] Important claims link to exact evidence, or this change does not produce claims.
- [ ] Privacy disclosures and the threat model are updated if data flow, retention, telemetry, or external services changed.
- [ ] New sample documents are synthetic, public-domain, or licensed for redistribution.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] Keyboard and responsive behavior checked for affected UI

Add screenshots or test output when they make the change easier to review. Never include private user documents.
